messages:
sam: Ran three rapid usability sessions today. New signups drop on the 'Your workspace' empty state. They expect an immediate demo or keyboard shortcut, not a tiny 'Add sample' link in muted text. rachel: Noted. Observed confusion too — users think samples are part of docs rather than importable starter apps. They ask 'is this a template or a tutorial?' and then leave. diego: Two priority fixes imo: (A) make the primary action unambiguous — text + visual, (B) give immediate affordance so they can preview before committing. tess: Accessibility report: screen reader announces "workspace empty" but focus lands on the top nav. The import action isn't first in tab order. Also color contrast for that tiny link fails AA in light mode. sam: Proposal: change CTA to a primary button "Import a sample project"; include a secondary plain link "Create an empty project". Add a row of three sample cards with tiny captions and meaningful alt text (no decorative images). Each card should open a preview modal with README highlights and estimated deploy time. morgan: Copy tweaks: replace "sample" with "starter project" in the CTA variants to reduce jargon for non-ML folks. Microcopy for the explainer: "Starter projects include runnable prompts, a demo endpoint, and a short README to get you calling the model." diego: We should instrument two metrics: (1) click-to-import rate, (2) time-to-first-successful-model-call. Also record impression->keyboard-interaction for accessibility funnel. tess: Implementation checklist from a11y side: ensure import button is a native Includes prompts, a demo endpoint, and a short README. Preview available.
``` morgan: Design asks: thumbnails should be real screenshots (not abstract blobs) to set expectations. Use lazy loading for images; include low-res placeholders. On mobile collapse cards into a single carousel with prominent CTA. diego: Engineering note: thumbnails must not bloat bundle. Serve them from the static CDN and lazy-load; fallback to illustration if unavailable. Also add a lightweight preview endpoint that returns README snippet + small demo gif to keep preview size <200KB. tess: Tests to add to onboarding-e2e: keyboard tab sequence starts inside empty-state, import button receives focus first, opening preview traps focus, and import completion announces success. Also color contrast checks for all variants. rachel: UX variant plan: V1 (three preview cards + primary CTA), V2 (single large preview + bullet benefits + CTA), V3 (compact list + inline quick-start link). Run for 2 weeks, segment by new users and by region, use click-through and conversion to model call as success metrics. sam: Action items: sam -> design mockups for V1/V2 (due Mon), diego -> prototype CDN thumbnails + preview endpoint (incubator branch), tess -> write accessibility test cases, morgan -> finalize microcopy and localization notes. I'll file a ticket and link the mocks. onboarding-bot: Task created: PRO-3474 "Starter project empty-state revamp" assigned to sam/diego/tess/morgan. Due 2026-04-06. :white_check_mark: sam: I'll drop the mocks in #design-review and ping product for prioritization when they're ready.
